home.morning: You woke at {who}'s place with breakfast on a tray, a kind word, and a friend for next time.
Tea, a lecture about your liver, and the dawn bus home. {who} waved you off from the door.
A mansion, a butler who called you 'sir' twice, and a dawn chase across the lawn by {who}'s husband.
At 4 a.m. a shoe came through {who}'s window. It was their spouse's. You kept the score and lost your own shoe.
You woke in the alley without your money or your coat. The dog was wearing your hat. {who} was nowhere.
A bathtub of ice, a note in {who}'s handwriting, a neat stitch. Every drink counts double now.
You woke with your fortune changed and a card in your pocket: {card}.
